Refund_not_showing_up: A refund has been issued or promised, but the money has not appeared in the account.
activate_my_card: How to activate a new card so it can be used.
age_limit: Minimum age, age restrictions, or eligibility for a child to open or use an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Adding or using a card with Apple Pay or Google Pay, including setup problems.
atm_support: Which ATMs or cash machines accept the card for cash withdrawals.
automatic_top_up: Setting up, changing, stopping, or troubleshooting automatic account top-ups.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: An incoming bank transfer was sent, but the receiving account balance has not increased.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash or a cheque was deposited, but the account balance has not increased.
beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer recipient or beneficiary is not allowed, unsupported, or blocked.
cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel or stop a money transfer they initiated.
card_about_to_expire: A card is expiring or has expired, and the customer needs renewal or replacement information.
card_acceptance: Where the card can be used for payments, including supported shops, websites, or countries.
card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived; the customer asks about its whereabouts, tracking, or a delivery delay.
card_delivery_estimate: Expected card delivery time, delivery dates, or options for faster delivery.
card_linking: Linking or relinking a card to the account or app so it appears there.
card_not_working: The card generally does not work, without a more specific stated payment status or technical problem.
card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or surcharge was charged for making a card payment.
card_payment_not_recognised: A card purchase or merchant payment appears that the customer does not recognise or authorise.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase in another currency seems wrong.
card_swallowed: An ATM retained or swallowed the customer's card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: An ATM withdrawal fee, cash withdrawal charge, or question about such charges.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears that the customer does not recognise or authorise.
change_pin: Changing the card PIN, including where and how a new PIN can be set.
compromised_card: The card or its details may be exposed, copied, or compromised; the customer wants to secure it.
contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap-to-pay payments with the card do not work.
country_support: Whether people living in a particular country can open an account or use the banking service.
declined_card_payment: A payment made with the card was explicitly declined or rejected.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An attempted ATM cash withdrawal was declined or refused.
declined_transfer: A money transfer was explicitly declined or rejected.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit appears that the customer does not recognise or authorise.
disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions on disposable virtual cards, including usage, spending, or how many can be created.
edit_personal_details: Changing personal account details such as name, address, phone number, or email.
exchange_charge: Fees or commissions for exchanging currencies, rather than the exchange rate itself.
exchange_rate: Which currency exchange rate is offered or how the rate is determined.
exchange_via_app: How to exchange one currency for another within the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: An extra small charge or verification amount appears on a statement, often around one unit of currency.
failed_transfer: A money transfer failed or could not be completed, without a specific stated beneficiary restriction or declined status.
fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account can hold, receive, or exchange.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting or creating a disposable, single-use virtual card.
get_physical_card: Obtaining, finding, or viewing the PIN for the physical card, including a PIN that has not arrived.
getting_spare_card: Getting an additional or spare card while keeping an existing card.
getting_virtual_card: Getting or creating a regular virtual card for online use.
lost_or_stolen_card: A physical card is lost or stolen; the customer needs to report, block, or replace it.
lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone is lost or stolen, affecting account access or security.
order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, including its price, ordering requirements, or delivery destinations.
passcode_forgotten: The app login passcode or password has been forgotten and needs recovery or reset.
pending_card_payment: A card payment remains pending or is awaiting completion.
pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal remains pending in the account.
pending_top_up: An account top-up remains pending or is still being processed.
pending_transfer: A money transfer remains pending or is still being processed.
pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked, often after too many incorrect attempts, and needs unblocking.
receiving_money: Receiving money from another person or an employer, including salary payments into the account.
request_refund: The customer wants to request a refund or dispute a card purchase to get their money back.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed or cancelled and its money returned to the account.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Which funding cards, card providers, or currencies are supported for card top-ups.
terminate_account: Closing, deleting, or terminating the account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for adding money to the account through an incoming bank transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: Fees or charges for adding money to the account with a payment card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Whether or how the account can be topped up by depositing cash or a cheque.
top_up_failed: An attempted card top-up failed or was declined, so the money could not be added.
top_up_limits: Minimum or maximum top-up amounts, frequency limits, or total top-up allowances.
top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed or cancelled after being initiated, with the money returned or due back to its source.
topping_up_by_card: How to add money using a payment card, including whose card can be used.
transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice or appears as a duplicate payment.
transfer_fee_charged: An outgoing money transfer incurred a fee or the recipient received less because of transfer charges.
transfer_into_account: How to fund the account by transferring money from another bank, including the account details to use.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: An outgoing transfer was sent, but the intended recipient has not received the money.
transfer_timing: How long a money transfer normally takes or when a recipient should expect it.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed, was rejected, or cannot be completed.
verify_my_identity: How to complete identity verification and which documents or steps are required.
verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or documenting where money came from, including proof of the source of funds.
verify_top_up: Verifying a funding card or card top-up, including locating and entering its verification code.
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work or cannot be used for a payment.
visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or whether the customer can choose the card network.
why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required or why the service asks for identity documents.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM dispensed too little cash, too much cash, or no cash despite an account debit.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal in another currency seems wrong.
